## 🎯 Problem Statement
Clear, objective description of the technical problem or feature requirement to be addressed.

## 📦 Accepted Artifact
- Core source code changes / pull request
- Automated unit test suite verifying the fix
- Architecture / technical documentation (if applicable)

## 🧪 Verification Method
- Command line to run tests: `npm test` or `go test ./...`
- Expected output and passing assertions

## 👤 Reviewer Requirement
- Code review by repository maintainers
- Verification of test coverage and code quality

## 💰 Reward Notes
- Bounty Amount: $[Amount] USD / Tokens
- Escrow / Payout details: [Platform link or wallet address]

## ⚠️ Failure Credit Rules & What Does NOT Count
- **Does NOT Count:** Incomplete submissions, unverified claims without code/tests, or duplicate pull requests.
- **Partial Credit:** Only granted if explicitly agreed upon by maintainers prior to submission.
